technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (MACD/PPO crossovers, OBV strength) show early bullish setup, but lack trend confirmation (low ADX), price remains below key moving averages, and money flow is weak—suitable for cautious swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: TER shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest, compounded by earnings announcement in 1 day creating elevated volatility risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (24/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (396.8), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings binary event create severe macro headwinds for IT sector positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO crossover up with OBV bullish strength and extreme fear sentiment (24/10) create contrarian entry opportunity near support (106.18) with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary within 1 day, VIX crisis regime (396.8), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, weak money flow (CMF negative), and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup in severe macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: MACD/PPO crossovers and OBV strength offer early momentum signal, and extreme fear sentiment (24/10) presents contrarian opportunity. However, earnings binary in 1 day combined with VIX crisis regime (396.8) and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement within 24 hours creates binary volatility event that can gap through technical support (106.18) regardless of momentum setup; macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising DXY, flat yield curve) amplify downside risk in IT sector.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to enter: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at 104.50 (below support); exit immediately post-earnings regardless of direction.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk; technical and sentiment show minor bullish signals but overwhelmed by fundamental weakness, earnings risk, and macro crisis conditions.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 13 positions in Information Technology (5.2% sector concentration); adding TER increases sector concentration risk during VIX crisis without offsetting fundamental or insider conviction.
